meaning: Source/document review attestations, not proof of semantic correctness or issue completion.

agents.review_note: Checked history cancellation, exact trace references, topic outcomes, owner attachments and source evidence against chat and monitoring.

auth.review_note: Checked owner-only report OAuth, single-use consent state, protected storage and agent and article history ownership boundaries.

commerce.review_note: Reconciled paid and pending dashboard views, HSN review groups, sorted lists, previewed CSV imports and atomic retry behavior.

content.review_note: Checked public search, dated Markdown visibility, CLI compare-and-swap, exact article revision restore and manual editor media.

foundation.review_note: Reviewed runtime integration and persistence boundaries for MySQL, private revisions, catalogue MCP, upload binaries and Google grants.

google-tags.review_note: Verified saved social metadata, Google reporting consent, API result handling and separation from public tracking tags.

http-errors.review_note: Checked search and product visibility, invalid CSV, rejected uploads, callback errors and private route responses against HTTP error handling.

interface.review_note: Checked phone and desktop shopping, scroll geometry, reused product actions and owner workspace interactions against design and skills.

mail.review_note: Checked Markdown publication and revision-restore paths for mail dispatch and retained the existing delivery and SMTP tests.

media.review_note: Checked thumbnail paging, referenced media guards and success and failure responses for the editor and agent upload workflows.

operator-help.review_note: Cross-checked the publishing, media, catalogue, Google reporting and monitoring help against their owner forms and tested routes.

sales-channels.review_note: Verified direct merchant correction links through pagination, retained feed visibility and read-only public catalogue outputs.

workflow.review_note: Reviewed CLI, test workflow, source indexes and documentation discovery for catalogue MCP, articles, imports and Chrome verification.
